### Locker filters

The Lunar locker (ClickGUI > Lunar > Locker) gets a filter row:

- **All / Owned / Picked**: everything, what your Lunar account owns, or what you've picked. On the Emotes tab, Picked shows the emotes on your wheel.
- **Newest / A-Z**: sort order.
- **Filters**: a panel with Lunar's colour tags (14 swatches, including Gold, Silver and Chroma) and the style tags the tab uses (Fire, Space, 8-bit, Glitch...). What's set shows as chips in the row; click a chip's x to remove it.
- **Clear**: resets the filters and the search.
- The search also matches style tags, so "fire" finds every fire-themed cloak.

### Lunar fixes

- **Animated Lunar cloaks load**: about 30 cloaks, including every Lunar+ cloak, the Fire, Skeppy Diamond, Heartrate and EuropeMC Crystal cloaks, failed to load because of a bug in the WebP image reader. Updated it (TwelveMonkeys 3.15.3).

### Lunar Client integration, new menus, Better Chat & Hypixel stats

- **Lunar Client (Misc > Lunar Spoof)**: Horizon passes as Lunar Client (brand, Apollo handshake), shows Lunar's logo and badges by Lunar players in the tab list and on name tags, and draws other players' **Lunar cosmetics**: cloaks (animated too), 3D models, emotes and particles. Cosmetics and the Lunar network are off by default.
- **Lunar menu** (ClickGUI top bar): your locker, a Lunar friends list with chat, your profile and an emote wheel. Servers running Apollo get their features (glow, coloured fire, name tags and more).
- **New menus**: the title screen has its buttons in a left column and a Rejoin row for the last server. The connecting, disconnected, server edit, direct connect, worlds and options screens share the same look. New **Monochrome** theme.
- **Better Chat**: Inter chat font and a restyled chat pane.
- **Hypixel**: `.hypixel` command for player stats, a **Hypixel Stats** HUD widget, and Party Protect fixes.
- **Aura**: new `aim-model` setting for LEGIT rotations. SPRING (the default) is unchanged. HUMAN moves like a real hand: flicks that speed up and slow down, small misses and corrections, reaction delay, and smooth tracking while you strafe.
- The auto-updater now checks the Horizon-2.1 repository.

- **WaveyCapes Cloth Physics**: 16-point 3D Verlet integration (StickSimulation3d), smooth multi-matrix continuous mesh with averaged Phong normals, streamlined **Cape** settings, and cached cape texture lookups.

releases.notes:
### Major Feature Update: 10 New Modules

- **BedAura** (Attack): Fast autonomous Bed bombing in Nether & End. Smart yaw placement (North/South/East/West), power 5.0 damage prediction, anti-suicide checks, auto-refill, silent swapping, and 3D shader/fill/outline ESP.
- **AnchorAura** (Attack): Autonomous 3-phase Respawn Anchor combat in Overworld & End. Places anchor -> charges with glowstone -> detonates with uncharged item/hand. Silent swapping, friendly protection, and 3D visual indicators.
- **HighwayBuilder** (World): Automatic road construction (1 to 5 blocks wide) with obsidian, netherrack, blue ice, or stone beneath player. Supports fast scaffolding across highways.
- **ChestAura** (World): Autonomous hands-free container looting. Automatically opens nearby chests, trapped chests, barrels, and shulkers with customizable reach and cooldown.
- **DiscordAlerts** (Misc): Webhook notifications for visual range alerts (enemy player spotted with distance and coordinates), totem pops, low health warnings, and base/stash discoveries. (Webhook URL defaults to empty until configured).
- **AutoMount** (Player): Automatically mounts nearby horses, donkeys, mules, boats, minecarts, pigs, and striders with sneak-to-dismount bypass.
- **EntityControl** (Rage): Full movement, steering, and jump control over ridden entities without requiring a saddle or carrot-on-a-stick.
- **AutoDrop** (Equip): Cleans clutter and unwanted junk (netherrack, cobblestone, diorite, seeds, etc.) while mining or digging, with inventory threshold and container safety.
- **ArmorAlert** (Protect): Real-time armor and elytra durability monitor with customizable warnings in chat or on-screen HUD when durability drops below threshold.
- **Ambience** (Cosmetic): Client-side custom time lock (Day, Noon, Sunset, Night, Midnight, Custom) with packet lock to prevent jitter, plus weather overrides (Clear, Rain, Thunder).

Tested and verified on Fabric 26.3.

releases.notes:
# Horizon 2.0 for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric)

Next-generation utility client engineered for anarchy PvP, high-speed travel, and modern aesthetics.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Modern Glassmorphism GUI**: Multi-window desktop interface with real-time HUD editor and Crimson Red theme.
- **Crystal PvP & Combat Engine**: AutoCrystal (tick-synced place & break with entity prediction), KillAura (Grim Silent, Snap, Vulcan bypasses), Surround, AutoTrap, and Offhand management.
- **Hunt Map**: Interactive world map with region-level caching and seed terrain generator for 2b2t & 6b6t.
- **Highway Navigation**: Elytra Autopilot & ElytraPlus high-speed bounce oscillation transit.
- **Ghost & Legit Suite**: Human-variance AutoClicker, smooth AimAssist, Trigger, and LegitTotem.
- **Tactile Audio**: Clean, subtle UI pops for window operations and config loading/saving.

### 📦 Installation
1. Install **Fabric Loader 0.20+** for **Minecraft 26.3**.
2. Install **Fabric API**.
3. Place \horizon-26.3-0.1.0.jar\ in your \.minecraft/mods\ directory.
4. Launch and press \Right Shift\ or \I\ to open the GUI!
